text:
<start_of_turn>user
What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for CSE semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (CSE).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your CSE Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your MECH Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:
<start_of_turn>user
What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for ISE semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (ISE).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your ISE Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:
<start_of_turn>user
My attendance in CSE is 68%. Can I still get my exam hall ticket?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Attendance Condonation Procedure (CSE)

- **Condonation Window:** Since your attendance is 68% (within the 65% to 74% condonation band), you are eligible to apply for condonation on valid medical grounds.
- **Required Documents:**
  1. Medical certificate from a registered campus or government medical officer.
  2. Formal condonation application signed by your parent/guardian.
  3. Endorsement from your CSE Class Teacher.
- **Submission Deadline:** Submit your dossier to the CSE Department office at least 5 working days before hall tickets are released.<end_of_turn>

What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for MECH semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (MECH).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your MECH Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:
<start_of_turn>user
What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for AIML semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (AIML).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your AIML Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:

My attendance in ISE is 68%. Can I still get my exam hall ticket?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Attendance Condonation Procedure (ISE)

- **Condonation Window:** Since your attendance is 68% (within the 65% to 74% condonation band), you are eligible to apply for condonation on valid medical grounds.
- **Required Documents:**
  1. Medical certificate from a registered campus or government medical officer.
  2. Formal condonation application signed by your parent/guardian.
  3. Endorsement from your ISE Class Teacher.
- **Submission Deadline:** Submit your dossier to the ISE Department office at least 5 working days before hall tickets are released.<end_of_turn>

- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your MECH Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for ISE semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (ISE).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your ISE Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for CSE semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (CSE).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your CSE Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:

- **Required Documents:**
  1. Medical certificate from a registered campus or government medical officer.

  3. Endorsement from your AIML Class Teacher.
- **Submission Deadline:** Submit your dossier to the AIML Department office at least 5 working days before hall tickets are released.<end_of_turn>

text:
<start_of_turn>user
What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for MECH semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (MECH).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your MECH Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:
<start_of_turn>user
My attendance in AIML is 68%. Can I still get my exam hall ticket?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Attendance Condonation Procedure (AIML)

- **Condonation Window:** Since your attendance is 68% (within the 65% to 74% condonation band), you are eligible to apply for condonation on valid medical grounds.
- **Required Documents:**
  1. Medical certificate from a registered campus or government medical officer.
  2. Formal condonation application signed by your parent/guardian.
  3. Endorsement from your AIML Class Teacher.
- **Submission Deadline:** Submit your dossier to the AIML Department office at least 5 working days before hall tickets are released.<end_of_turn>

text:

What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for ECE semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (ECE).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your ECE Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:

What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for ECE semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (ECE).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your ECE Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for MECH semester exams?<end_of_turn>

### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your MECH Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:
<start_of_turn>user
What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for AIML semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (AIML).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your AIML Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:

My attendance in BT is 68%. Can I still get my exam hall ticket?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Attendance Condonation Procedure (BT)

- **Condonation Window:** Since your attendance is 68% (within the 65% to 74% condonation band), you are eligible to apply for condonation on valid medical grounds.
- **Required Documents:**
  1. Medical certificate from a registered campus or government medical officer.
  2. Formal condonation application signed by your parent/guardian.
  3. Endorsement from your BT Class Teacher.
- **Submission Deadline:** Submit your dossier to the BT Department office at least 5 working days before hall tickets are released.<end_of_turn>

text:
<start_of_turn>user
What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for BT semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (BT).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your BT Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:
<start_of_turn>user
My attendance in CSE is 68%. Can I still get my exam hall ticket?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Attendance Condonation Procedure (CSE)

- **Condonation Window:** Since your attendance is 68% (within the 65% to 74% condonation band), you are eligible to apply for condonation on valid medical grounds.
- **Required Documents:**
  1. Medical certificate from a registered campus or government medical officer.
  2. Formal condonation application signed by your parent/guardian.
  3. Endorsement from your CSE Class Teacher.
- **Submission Deadline:** Submit your dossier to the CSE Department office at least 5 working days before hall tickets are released.<end_of_turn>

What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for CSE semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (CSE).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your CSE Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:
<start_of_turn>user
What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for ECE semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (ECE).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your ECE Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

text:
<start_of_turn>user
My attendance in AIML is 68%. Can I still get my exam hall ticket?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Attendance Condonation Procedure (AIML)

- **Condonation Window:** Since your attendance is 68% (within the 65% to 74% condonation band), you are eligible to apply for condonation on valid medical grounds.
- **Required Documents:**
  1. Medical certificate from a registered campus or government medical officer.
  2. Formal condonation application signed by your parent/guardian.
  3. Endorsement from your AIML Class Teacher.
- **Submission Deadline:** Submit your dossier to the AIML Department office at least 5 working days before hall tickets are released.<end_of_turn>

What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for AIML semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.
- **Medical Condonation:** Attendance between **65% and 74%** may be condoned by the Academic Council upon submission of verified medical documentation and approval from the Head of Department (AIML).
- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your AIML Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>

What is the attendance requirement to be eligible for ECE semester exams?<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
### Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy

- **Mandatory Attendance:** A minimum of **75% attendance** in every registered course is strictly required to be eligible for the semester-end theory and laboratory examinations.

- **Below 65% Shortage:** Students with attendance below 65% are strictly detained (NSAR) and cannot appear for semester examinations as per university bylaws.

Feel free to check your real-time attendance ledger or consult your ECE Department faculty coordinator for attendance verification.<end_of_turn>
